text:
alex: Noting a new flake in the int4 bringup: ~2.6% of mirrored sessions show two func_call starts reaching the adapter. Not parse error, just duplicate tool_start.
rachael: Saw that too. Likely streaming chunk reassembly + retry. Both calls look semantically identical but have different transient ids.
min: Do we have a minimal repro?
alex: Example (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-22T08:11:02Z] recv seq=0 {"fn":"addr_lookup","args":{"q":"10 Downing"},"_chunk":"t=0..18"}
[runtime] retry due to client_ack_timeout tmp_id=T123
[2026-03-22T08:11:03Z] recv seq=1 {"fn":"addr_lookup","args":{"q":"10 Downing"},"_chunk":"t=0..44"}
```
adapter treats as separate because id != tmp_id.
rachael: Short-term idea: compute a canonical fingerprint (tool + normalized args) and dedupe within a sliding window (5s). Canonicalization: sort keys, collapse whitespace, normalize common escapes, strip trailing commas.
min: Risk: suppressing legitimate retry with updated args. Add an arg-diff threshold and emit metric suppressed_retry.
ops-bot: @alex Requested AB rollout: model=raven-int4-canary flag=fp_dedupe scope=1pct queued.
ml-ci: I'll wire a mirror harness to sample 20k sessions, store 150 raw+repaired artifacts to restricted bucket, and compute tokenization delta histogram.
rachael: Also we should keep raw payloads until we validate repair heuristics. Repair can hide root cause.
min: Long-term: move idempotency token into runtime so retries preserve same id. That removes heuristic.
alex: Plan of record: 1) min implements fingerprint algorithm + tests; 2) ml-ci runs 1% AB for 12h and posts dup rate, suppressed_retry, latency delta; 3) rachael collects raw artifacts (100) for canonicalizer tuning. Abort AB if tool error rate or latency jumps.
rachael: I'll add dashboard tile for duplicate_tool_start and suppressed_retry.
min: CL by EOD for review.
alex: Thanks folks ":thumbsup:". Will follow up with initial metrics.
